name: Hadiya Finley
short_bio: Hadiya Finley is a sculptor working in bronze and mixed media, making figures of the female form from miniature to life size.

sources.label: Tacoma Arts Month: Tacoma Studio Tour 2026 artist map

biography: Hadiya Finley makes sculpture of the female figure in bronze and mixed media, at scales from miniature to life size. Her work draws on assemblage and found objects.

She studied with assemblage artist George Herms, and describes her practice as growing from a childhood habit of turning discarded materials into figures and small worlds into an approach that reworks what she finds into unified pieces.
